<thought>Based on the observed isotopic pattern—a dominant peak followed by progressively smaller peaks at +1 Da intervals with intensities ~11 %, ~0.5 %, ~0.016 %—the distribution matches the natural carbon isotopic envelope (13C ≈1.1 % per carbon). No other element shows a characteristic pattern (e.g., Cl, Br, S). Therefore, carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
